title: Tap package
description: A package definition compiled into Tap's catalog by go generate.

name.description: Package name. Defaults to the YAML filename without .yml.

description.description: Short description displayed by tap find and tap info.

source.description: GitHub releases or the dedicated Go/Zig installer using official downloads.

repository.description: GitHub owner/repository. Required when source is github or omitted.

prefix.description: Release tag prefix. Use an empty string for bare version tags.

binary.description: Executable name without the platform extension. Defaults to the filename stem; Go/Zig require their source name.

args.description: Arguments used to query the installed version. Defaults to [--version], or [version] for Go/Zig. An empty array invokes the binary without arguments.

asset.description: Default GitHub release asset template, overridden by platform entries.

platforms.description: Supported platforms and their overrides. Omit this map to support both Linux and Windows amd64.

asset.description: Release asset filename. Supports {name}, {binary}, {version}, {tag}, {os}, {arch} and {ext}. Empty platform values inherit the package asset.

executable.description: Relative archive member path using forward slashes. Omit or leave empty to find a unique matching binary filename. Supports the same placeholders as asset.

path.description: Destination executable path, starting with {bin}/ or {home}/. Supports {name}, {binary}, {os}, {arch}, {ext}, {bin} and {home}; version-dependent paths are not allowed. Empty values use the default.

toolchainTarget.description: Go and Zig use official downloads and fixed install locations; platform overrides must be empty.
